messages.author: c9416b6005bf4eb7
messages.subject: please log on and accept terms for 2026
parts:
Hi admins and mentors,
R has been accepted again for GSOC26!
yay!
Stephanie has asked me to add admins and mentors, but I can’t until
you log on and accept the new terms of service on
https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com
Can you do that please, and then post a message here to remind me to add you?
Also now is the time for mentors to add project ideas,
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2026/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects
Thanks
Toby
